name: helper-visible-sharing
goal: Every listed helper has at least two distinct component, service or model links in Used In, with eligibility and display using the same resolved consumer set

evidence: Previous Used In UI 5f3e02d7 exposed a mismatch: broad helperContract counts named-function consumers while visible links resolve only component/service/model unit ids. Ten actual cards include zero/one visible users. Align inclusion with that same visible set; no card design change.

Existing card SSR explicitly accepted a dash for zero visible consumers, and browser fixture only had one positively shared helper. Extend shared fixture with zero/one/missing/same-unit different-symbol cases, change the normal card assertion to exclude all below threshold, and retain two/three-user cases. Test typecheck and lint pass before freezing.

Frozen test commit 0d1249ee fails in all three viewports with only helpers used in two distinct visible places are listed: five cards are present instead of the single qualifying helper. Record 41cfb79dcd3608d503661b06ac0e757c7cb2dff62abbfac087f6f6c3d6e82e2d; before screenshots /tmp/harness-helper-sharing-before.

Filter each helper row with its already resolved distinct Used In links >=2, retaining purity and three-link display cap. Strengthen the project acceptance-review rule so eligibility thresholds and visible summaries share the same set, and keep below-threshold examples in standard unit/browser tests. Verify rejection by restoring old inclusion in an isolated archive.

Entity catalog now filters each pure helper by the same deduplicated eligible Used In set (at least two). Existing three-link cap is above the threshold and preserves that decision. Updated unit responsibility and project Catalog Threshold Review to require shared-set eligibility and boundary cases.

Frozen 0d1249ee fails, exact same tests/fixtures/command/environment pass at 43697a0f. Green record 9df47905c525f9dd6858dbb4fada0b66c21d28bff8a0a24277a78b89e6527587. Svelte types, all three viewport cases and 19 unit tests pass.

Isolated archive of 43697a0f: replacing the visible >=2 predicate with old allow-all inclusion makes unchanged standardized unit tests fail with zero or one visible consumer is private (exit 1). Restoring exact source passes the same 19 tests (exit 0). Logs /tmp/harness-helper-sharing-guard-{red,green}.log.
